description: Static registry of known skill types available in the marketplace. Used by the planner to decompose user intents into executable steps.

skills.description: Condense long text or documents into a shorter version preserving key points
Translate text from one language to another
Categorize content into predefined or inferred labels
Identify and extract named entities like people, organizations, dates, amounts from text
Extract structured fields from unstructured documents like invoices, receipts, or forms
Determine the emotional tone or opinion expressed in text
Analyze source code for bugs, quality issues, and improvement suggestions
Detect security vulnerabilities and compliance issues in code or configurations
Produce new text content from a prompt or instructions
Rephrase or restructure existing text for clarity, tone, or audience
Extract text from images or scanned documents
Answer questions based on a provided context or document
Analyze legal clauses, provisions, risks, and obligations in documents
Transform data from one structured format to another
Identify differences and similarities between two or more documents or datasets
Check data or documents against rules, schemas, or standards for correctness
